title: all-hands-nov-2026-talking-points-and-qa-draft
content:
SPEAKER NOTES / DRAFT OUTLINE - All-hands Nov 2026

Goal: give concise update on where we are (latency/cost/reliability), surface milestones for Dedicated & Private, celebrate wins, and prepare for Q&A. Keep it ~10 minutes.

Opening (20-30s)
- Quick thank-you and context: big push this quarter on reliability and customer readiness for Private.
- One-liner: "We shipped improvements that make inference cheaper and more reliable at scale — and we have a clear path to making Private deployments feel as easy as hosted."

Key updates (4-5 mins)
1) Hosted API: incremental improvements
- Rolling out streaming improvements for lower tail latency on multimodal requests. Observed median latency down ~12% on standard gen workloads. [INSERT PERF DASHBOARD GIF / metric]
- Usage: GA/API calls up 28% q/q in self-serve cohort. Top use-cases: chat assistants, agent orchestration.
- Notes to self: call out example customer (anonymized) that dropped costs by 18% after switching to prefix caching.

2) Redwood Dedicated (reserved capacity)
- Live with 12 enterprise customers on monthly commits. New autoscale policies let teams safely burst while keeping reserved baseline.
- Reliability: 99.95% regional SLOs in Sept/Oct. Need to mention recent incident that triggered improved fallback routing — short note and what we fixed.
- TODO: pull incident postmortem link for follow-up.

3) Redwood Private (VPC/on-prem)
- Beta customers onboarding — two customers in security review stage, one pilot on-prem completed.
- What's next: simplified KMS onboarding flow, add HSM connector in Nov.
- Messaging: emphasize auditability, data controls, and parity with hosted APIs (same API surface).

4) Redwood Console / Observability
- New per-route token cost breakdown rolling out to all accounts next week. Helps engineers tune prompts and routing.
- Example: cost regression alert flagged a prompt drift in a fintech customer — saved ~12% monthly spend after we suggested a batching tweak.

5) Redwood Optimize (cost/perf toolkit)
- Recommenders: model + quantization suggestions now in preview. First adopters seeing ~30% inference-op cost reduction in eval workloads.
- Next: expand to multi-model routing suggestions (latency vs cost tradeoff).

Shoutouts (20-30s)
- SRE + serving runtime team for the new kernel selection work (huge perf win).
- Solutions eng + sales for moving pilot to committed deal.
- Hiring shout: infra SWE reqs still open (link in Slack).

Q&A PREP (anticipated Qs and short answers)
Q: Are we changing pricing?
A: No immediate pricing changes for hosted API. We're focused on tooling (Optimize) to lower customer unit costs; any pricing work will be separately communicated with plenty of notice.

Q: How does Private compare feature-wise to hosted?
A: Feature parity is a priority — same API, key observability features, and we're adding KMS/HSM integrations to meet enterprise controls. Timeline: most parity features in H1 2027, critical flows (rollouts, metrics) polished by Q1 2027.

Q: What happened in the reliability incident last month?
A: Short summary: contention in a new batching path caused degraded tail latency for a small set of routing configs. Mitigation: automatic fallback to stable kernel selection, hotfix to batching logic, and extended e2e tests added. Postmortem link: [INSERT].

Q: Are we expanding regions?
A: Yes — we're adding APAC capacity with partners in early 2027; timeline depends on partner onboarding and demand.

Open talking points / notes to self / TODOs
- Insert visuals: perf graphs (median vs p95), cost-savings chart, 2 customer quotes.
- Confirm numbers with analytics: median latency improvement, % cost reduction examples.
- Get sign-off from Eng leads on Private timeline wording.
- Remove internal incident details if legal/ops flags them.
- Finalize Q&A doc and share with LT 48 hours before all-hands.

Tone: optimistic, engineer-first, pragmatic about reliability. Avoid overpromising timelines; emphasize measurable wins and clear next steps.

ROUGH Q&A SHEET (for moderators)
- "Can we demo Private?" => "We have recorded demo; in-person pilots scheduled for customers under NDA; roadmap for self-serve Private in 2027."
- "Will Optimize be free?" => "Optimize recommendations are part of platform; advanced features will be paid add-on."
- "What to do if latency spikes?" => "Use per-route fallback policies and the console trace to identify hot prompts; contact SRE for escalation."

----
Notes to self: keep this file as the working draft. After review, I'll create a cleaned version for Confluence plus a one-pager for the all-hands slide deck.

END OF DRAFT
